notes: Sides: just inside the inner straight rule that runs inside the thick bar. The frame bows outward on every side (up to ~15 px off a straight corner-to-corner line at mid-top), so points were added along each side where the rule was measured on 8x crops. Corners now follow the inner arc, per the owner (README rule 2): at each corner the edge runs ~3 px inside the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc, points every ~15-30 px, joining the side rule where the arc merges into it; the arcs, the corner-triangle ink and everything between them and the corner are outside. Blocks touch the inner rule on the left side; the edge keeps the rule outside. Holes (README rule 4, floating blocks are frame): (1) the CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP title, LEGEND and scale bar block (top right, on blank bay paper); (2) the compass rose with its north arrow, needle and tail (right, over the bay); the dashed diagonal bay line (pier-head/bulkhead line) runs straight through the rose, so a ~300 px stretch of that map line falls inside this hole; (3) the SECTION 10 circle badge (top right corner). 'Join Sec. 9' (top) and 'Join Sec. 11' (left) are printed outside the frame bars, so already outside. The BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, SOUTH BASIN and ISLAIS CREEK CHANNEL lettering name places and stay map.
